bounty.description: Extreme Conquest Quest Lv.1000 (Soaring in the Skies)
rules: GR Weapon craft (Include Gou, Supremacy, Exotic)
Bring Rasta or Partner count as Multiplayer (No Magnet Spike)
Send the screenshot with your equipment set when your quest done
If you do the bounty in Multiplayer all the player must send the screenshot of the armor set too
If there's the player who not send the screenshot of his armor set, the reward cannot be claim
